title: Deadly Crash Involving Cement Truck on Kushla McLeod Road
text:
A fatal collision between a cement truck and another vehicle occurred on Kushla McLeod Road, leaving one person dead and the vehicle on fire.
) - A witness describes the scene on Kushla McLeod Road after investigators say a cement truck and another vehicle were involved in a deadly crash.
This was the scene Wednesday afternoon. Smoke could be seen coming from a crushed vehicle, along with an ambulance, firetruck and other first responders. Mobile County EMS said two ambulances responded to the scene, with one having a critical care paramedic.
“May need all hands on deck for this one,” a responder said, according to radio traffic obtained by Broadcastify. “Vehicle is still on fire. There is one confirmed fatality. ” This was the aftermath.
A black patch from the fire, tire marks going toward the ditch, ripped up grass and debris could be seen. One witness, who didn’t want to go on camera, told FOX10 News she was in the area when she saw both vehicles in the ditch.
“The truck was smooshed. It was on fire and it was something you don’t ever want to see,” the witness said.
“That’s very sad for whoever’s family, whoever that was. All I can do is just keep praying,” the witness said. Tonight, many questions still remain. FOX10 News reached out to the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency asking about a possible cause for the crash, details about the victim, and if anyone will face charges.
